The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''3632 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''' was a period of galactic history. That year, the anarchist [[Kaliyo Djannis]] arrived on Zakuul and began a campaign of bombings in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]. [[Leontyne Saresh]]'s terms limits as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ran out in that year, and she was succeeded by [[Jebevel Madon]].
